tasks.title: Create, edit and delete checks with revision checks, current authorization and People-log outcomes
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, mutation behavior and check-outcome/server.checks-write/forms/people-log/form-token/security Checks; R4-R6 numbered commit orders, R8-R9; Decisions 4, 6-10, 13-14; Counterexamples (Form size, Revision, Shadowing during edit, Delete, Roles, Unknown outcome, Outcome classes, Edit uses the trusted entry, Delete uses the trusted name, Expired and replayed tokens, Ids `.` and `..`); Security impact. Register editors/delete and activate actions using T2 forms. Create validates fields/JSON size before its fresh config read; edit/delete read GET /admin/config at step 2 before field or typed-name validation, derive source/target and compare the shown revision, then validate only against that trusted entry. On edit GET and POST, check membership in shadowed before absence from checks or effective file ownership; a shadowed id also has an effective file entry, so checking file ownership first is wrong. A free __proto__ header row returns the R4 local 422 field error with no outbound mutation. Preserve the form revision for PUT/DELETE. Failed reads and stale revisions show safe input as text without a form and send no write. Add route-specific form limits in the existing dispatch order. Recheck session and stored role immediately before dispatch after all awaited reads/checks; use small account-store bridges/tests for existing credential guard and People insertion without exposing a raw database to routes. Implement pure checkOutcome with literal table-driven cases and response-metadata classification in R8 order; check-write maps each class to status/text/log/People row. No redirect or retry. Use apiIdSegment at each mutation call; reject '.'/'..' GET/POST edit/delete with 409 and only a config read. Implement synchronous token-refusal rendering and optional reopenHrefOf: expired edit/delete offers an encoded-id link without form/input/API reads, create recovers posted type/non-secret fields, replay links retain id, other routes retain existing behavior. Pair each behavior with unit/HTTP/race tests here and update mutation docs; T4 completes browser/stack evidence.
